title: Tremors
description:
S1
Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.

title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
description:
S1
The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.

title: The Werewolf of London
description:
S1
An Asian werewolf (Warner Oland) bites a botanist (Henry Hull) in Tibet and rivals him for the antidote in London.

title: The Wolf Man
description:
S1
Bitten by a werewolf, an aristocrat (Lon Chaney) grows fangs, fur and a muzzle, then begs his father (Claude Rains) for help.

title: Altered
description:
S1
Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.

title: Animal
description:
S1
When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

title: The Atticus Institute
description:
S1
In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

title: Beneath
description:
S1
Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

title: The Birds II: Land's End
description:
S1
Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
description:
S1
A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.
